name: nhcx
description: Agent skills for building on the National Health Claims Exchange (NHCX), one per use case in episode order: nhcx-coverage, nhcx-insurance, nhcx-preauth, nhcx-claim, nhcx-payment, nhcx-communication and nhcx-reprocess. Each builds its use case into a hospital information system or a claims desk, held to the NHCX package's pinned FHIR bundles, and installs and runs alone. Also carries /nhcx-decode-error, /nhcx-preflight and /nhcx-prove-seal, and the nhcx-call-debugger agent.
